items.name: Tenkokudō（てん刻堂）
items.short: Traditional Japanese tenkoku seals, handcrafted from stone. More than 2,000 original seals created over 20 years.
items.description:
Tenkokudō presents the traditional Japanese art of tenkoku – the hand carving of seals in stone. Their vivid red impressions, also known as rakkan, are used for example as a personal signature or as a finishing element on calligraphy and works of art.

The artist has been creating these seals in Japan for 20 years and has handcrafted more than 2,000 original pieces during that time. Each seal is made individually and can feature a name, selected characters or a simple pictorial motif.

At Japan Day, visitors will be able to see examples of previously created impressions and finished works. It is also possible to order a unique custom seal carved by hand from stone. Production is made to order and usually takes approximately four weeks.

items.name: SAMURAI.cz
items.short: Premium kitchen knives, Damascus blades and Japanese knife types such as Santoku, Gyuto, Kiritsuke and Nakiri.
items.description: SAMURAI.cz focuses on premium kitchen knives with an emphasis on sharpness, precision and quality craftsmanship. Its range includes Japanese knife types such as Santoku, Gyuto, Kiritsuke and Nakiri, as well as knives designed for preparing sushi and sashimi. The assortment also includes Damascus knives, hand-forged models and knives using premium steels such as VG10 and modern powder steels. At Japan Day, visitors will be able to discover different types of kitchen knives and learn more about their use in Japanese gastronomy.
